name: Encrusted Tail Fins
summary: Wizzle Brassbolts at the Mirage Raceway fears the rocket car is so fast that friction will tear it apart. To protect it, he needs tail fins from the Saltscale murlocs at the Vile Reef, off the coast of Stranglethorn Vale.

sections.title: A Coating for the Car
sections.body: Wizzle calls the rocket car the fastest thing on the Shimmering Flats, and worries that friction will tear it apart. The moving parts need a coat of composite that is hard but not brittle, and able to resist salt corrosion, or the flats will eat the car away. Its key ingredient is the tail fins of the Saltscale murlocs, who live at the Vile Reef, off the coast of Stranglethorn Vale. You are asked to bring Wizzle ten of them.

sections.title: The Finished Composite
sections.body: Wizzle will grind your fins to powder and mix them with a few other ingredients, and the finished composite should keep the car safe from its own speed. Wizzle adds that this holds only as long as the car does not hit anything.

faq.q: Why does Wizzle Brassbolts need encrusted tail fins?
faq.answer: The rocket car is so fast that Wizzle fears friction will tear it apart. The fins are a crucial ingredient of a composite to coat its moving parts, one hard but not brittle, and resistant to salt corrosion.

faq.q: Where can the Saltscale murlocs be found?
faq.answer: At the Vile Reef, off the coast of Stranglethorn Vale, lying almost due west of Grom'gol Base Camp.

faq.q: What came before this for Wizzle?
faq.answer: Hardened Shells comes before it in the chain.
Wizzle Brassbolts is at the Mirage Raceway, worried for the rocket car, and is the one who asks you for the fins.
